\chapter{Rodents in a made-up valley}
\label{ch:rodents}

\section{Trapping}

Traps were set in 12 villages \citep{Doe2015}. Captures rose to 10\,000 per year \citep[e.g.][]{Doe2015,Roe2019}.
% A comment line inside a paragraph does not end it.
The rate was 1,234 animals per site, as \citet{Roe2019} found (Figure~\ref{fig:traps}). % a trailing note
Prof.~Smith counted 45\% of them \cite{Poe2001}.
